I am writing to let you know the disappointed evening I had seen your show with the worst services I have ever seen.
First of all, in the ticket for entrance says that the actor was Danny Brook and realy he was not.
In the show apears a different actor, so I was very disappointed.
Then, in the ticket says that the show started at 19.30 and, I don't know why, it started at 20:15, very unpolited of your side, and also, make me lose time.
Other thing is that in the ticket apears that discounts were available but when I asked for it, there was no one.
The last thing is that you invited us to visit your restaurant after the show, but it was closed because the food was not already done.
